expr: (let subArrays := List.range (sequence.length + 1) |>.flatMap (fun start => List.range (sequence.length - start + 1) |>.map (fun len => sequence.drop start |>.take len)); let subArraySums := subArrays.filter (· ≠ []) |>.map (·.sum); subArraySums.foldl max (subArraySums.headD 0))

lemmas.name: ms75
lemmas.statement: ∀ (sequence : List Int) (h : task_code_precond sequence), task_code_postcond sequence (let subArrays := List.range (sequence.length + 1) |>.flatMap (fun start => List.range (sequence.length - start + 1) |>.map (fun len => sequence.drop start |>.take len)); let subArraySums := subArrays.filter (· ≠ []) |>.map (·.sum); subArraySums.foldl max (subArraySums.headD 0)) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro sequence h
  unfold task_code_postcond
  exact Refine.maxlist_int _ (List.ne_nil_of_mem (a := ((sequence.drop 0).take 1).sum) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(sequence.drop 0).take 1, List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨0, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), List.mem_map.mpr ⟨1, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), rfl⟩⟩, by rcases sequence with _ | ⟨x, t⟩ <;> simp_all⟩, rfl⟩))
